_about: One release entry in the release format. The build renders it on the home page (What's new); the changelog pages reuse it. Every output line is copied from a real run; whole lines are cut to fit, no line is edited. The exit lines are the recorded exit codes.
label: Behavior change
headline: sweep now continues the sorting you already started

lead.text: is already there, sweep 0.5.5 moves one or two matching files into it and exits with code 0. Version 0.5.4 left those 2 files where they were and exited with code 1.

output: 2 files matched no group and were left where they are

note.text: A new folder still needs 3 or more files. No flag needed. To put the 2 files back, run

footer: Both outputs come from real runs of two builds: tag sweep-v0.5.4 (commit de8f307) and the 0.5.5 release candidate at commit 9533530, not tagged yet. Each ran the same commands on a fresh copy of one synthetic folder, inbox: a Documents folder with 3 PDFs, and 2 new PDFs loose next to it. Output is shortened to fit by cutting whole lines. Nothing outside the scratch folder was touched.
